nodes.description: Limb malformations of the radial ray and the hand and foot rays, including radial ray defects, polydactyly and split hand/foot, occur in part of the affected individuals.

evidence.reference_title: Monoallelic and biallelic variants in LEF1 are associated with a new syndrome combining ectodermal dysplasia and limb malformations caused by altered WNT signaling.
evidence.snippet: The phenotypic spectrum includes various limb malformations, such as radial ray defects, polydactyly or split hand/foot, and ectodermal dysplasia.

nodes.description: Tooth, hair follicle and sweat gland development depend on reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signalling in which LEF1 is required in the epithelium and mesenchyme at successive stages. Reduced LEF1 activity impairs the formation of these ectodermal appendages, producing oligodontia, sparse hair and hypohidrosis.

evidence.reference_title: Development of several organs that require inductive epithelial-mesenchymal interactions is impaired in LEF-1-deficient mice.
evidence.snippet: The mutant mice lack teeth, mammary glands, whiskers, and hair but show no obvious defects in lymphoid cell populations at birth.

evidence.reference_title: Lef1 expression is activated by BMP-4 and regulates inductive tissue interactions in tooth and hair development.
evidence.snippet: Subsequent formation of a whisker and tooth mesenchymal papilla and completion of organogenesis require transient expression of Lef1 in the epithelium.
